title: Day 25 devlog: i moved the whole game from unity to unreal, and now theres a grey arena where i can finally fight stuff
author: SuperbActuator6555
selftext:
tldr: since last post (day 17) i spent a few days polishing the unity version (sky, water, slime attacks, character animations) and then decided to move the client to unreal engine 5. the valley already looks almost the same as the unity one. game logic now runs on its own server and the client just draws. theres a plain grey combat arena w/ a wolf, a shield goblin and a boss, perfect dodge and parry, weapons in the hand, and a little tool to pick animations by playing. lock on (dark souls style) is in progress. yes i make this w/ claude, same as always

https://i.redd.it/zxa16bzs0ovh1.png

**the days before the switch**

first the stuff that still happened in unity. the mountains in the distance are now chains of pieces w/ parallax, and some clouds sit between the layers, which sells the depth way more than i expected. i also deleted a bunch of clouds that looked like flat plates floating around, they were bad

https://i.redd.it/quj880zx0ovh1.png

the slime got its water attacks. first a little spit, which looked bad at first because the bubble just appeared out of nowhere from a body standing still. now it forms in front of the slime, the slime leans back and then pushes it out. i also made a continuous water beam, kind of like hydro pump. its still rough (the beam is a plain tube rn) but it works

https://i.redd.it/opjs51731ovh1.png

https://i.redd.it/1f4a37m71ovh1.png

small fix: i kept feeling like a tiny person in the world and was convinced the sizes of trees and houses were off. nope, it was the scale of the ground texture, one leaf of the painted ground was as big as the characters boot. made it way smaller and suddenly the player felt like a normal sized guy

**why unreal**

short version: every animation i wanted was a fight. i would spend a whole day on a jump or a roll and it still looked meh. unreal has a huge ecosystem of ready made animations (mocap packs from fab and a few other places) and i can just retarget them to my character. the argument fixing the look is a one time job, animating every creature in the game is a job forever.

it failed the first time btw. i opened the unreal valley and it looked nothing like the unity one. grass too thick, mountains flat. so i changed the method: no more “proof of concept”, i port one piece at a time and only accept it when it looks the same as unity in the same shot, side by side. sky first, then fog, grass, flowers, water, character, trees, rocks. thats the whole workflow now

the grass was the hardest one and took the most tries. every time i thought it was done the side by side showed something off (too dark, too sparse, wrong color in the sun). the trees sway in the wind now too

water is the part thats not as good yet. the lake in unreal moves and has the same colors, but the shore and the foam are simpler than what i had. its fine for now

https://i.redd.it/thfmkioi1ovh1.png

**the server thing**

in unity the game rules lived inside the game. now the rules run in their own server and the unreal client only draws what the server says and sends your inputs. its more work upfront but thats what an mmo needs anyway, and it means i can test fights without opening the engine at all

**combat gym**

so to test combat i built a plain grey level, flat floor, ramps, stairs, pits and walls, nothing pretty on purpose. ugly but you can see everything

https://i.redd.it/wj4qmzfg3ovh1.png

enemies in there rn are grey cylinders w/ a name and a health bar (the models come later), but the behavior is real:

* the wolf chases you, bites, and backs off when hurt. it respects the terrain now, it used to climb ramps you couldnt and see through walls, which was dumb
* the goblin has a sword and a shield. hit him from the front and it gets blocked, from the side or behind it goes through
* the boss has two phases, gets angrier at half life, and has a big area attack w/ a warning that you can dodge by rolling
* several enemies at once works now, and you cant walk through them anymore (rolling through them still happens sometimes, fixing that)

perfect dodge and perfect parry. if you roll or parry right as the hit lands you take no damage, and the enemy gets "stunned" for a bit. theres also a window after for a stronger counter, thats in the rules already, but the client only shows the text and the pose for now, the flashy part is missing

https://i.redd.it/ki6qvf3u3ovh1.png

weapons show up in the hand now (sword and a heavy axe, grey placeholders for the moment, the real ones come later). you swap with the mouse wheel and each weapon has its own set of moves

**lock on, in progress**

im building the dark souls style lock on. first version already works: you pick a target, a marker shows over its head, the camera stays on it and you can switch targets. in this video the character still runs facing wherever hes going, the part where he keeps facing the enemy while walking sideways and rolls relative to it is being hooked up right now. the camera is also rough. so dont take this video as the final thing

**the animation picker**

this one i made for myself. i downloaded a bunch of mocap packs and had hundreds of animations, no way im going to review them one by one in a folder. so theres a tool inside the game: it has a slot for each thing (walk, run, roll, parry...), you cycle through the candidates while playing, and press enter to keep the one you like. theres also a mode that lines up a row of dummies each doing a different one so you compare at once. some candidates were broken (legs under the floor, hips going through the ground) and i marked them to skip

**something that didnt work**

the first jump. i went through a bunch of versions in unity, built from poses, tweaking angles and timing, and it always looked stiff. a mocap clip looked better right away, which is basically why i switched. also the first combat video looked fine at a glance but watching it frame by frame the dash was floating (it was using a diving clip lol) and the camera was blurry

**ugly parts**

* i had to reformat my pc in the middle of all this. nothing important was lost luckily, but it was a scary night
* the unity version is still the one i can run around in fully, the unreal one only has the valley and the gym for now. not at parity yet
* the weekly token budget is still the real limit of this project, i had to pause some parts of the work to save it

**next**

finish the lock on, then put the real models on the wolf, goblin and boss and animate them. more of the world (houses, the village). a few more weapons. and then bring the rest of the game over piece by piece

still a free time project w/ basically no budget. day 25
